# contract address

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:contractAddress`](gmeow-contractAddress.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/contractAddress>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The address at which a smart contract is deployed.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:SmartContract`](../classes/gmeow-SmartContract.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:contractAddress`](gmeow-contractAddress.md) from [`gmeow:SmartContract`](../classes/gmeow-SmartContract.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:SmartContract`](../classes/gmeow-SmartContract.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the deployment address of a [`gmeow:SmartContract`](../classes/gmeow-SmartContract.md) — the on-chain location at which the program lives and is invoked.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a signing account's address ([`gmeow:signatureRecoveryAddress`](gmeow-signatureRecoveryAddress.md)) and for the chain identifier ([`gmeow:chainId`](gmeow-chainId.md)); this address points to deployed code, not a wallet or a network. Functional — one address per contract.

### How to use

- Set one address literal on the [`gmeow:SmartContract`](../classes/gmeow-SmartContract.md) and locate it on its [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](../classes/gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md); an address is unambiguous only together with its chain id.

### Examples

- ex:registry [`gmeow:contractAddress`](gmeow-contractAddress.md) "0x1234abcd...".
